title: Illinois Jaquet as a tap dancer in Fort Worth
summary: Barefield first met Jaquet in Fort Worth while with Cab, when he was in an amateur-night tap dance trio with a boxing routine.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: So later on Joe Newman did give me back, but Illinois -- so every time I see Joe now, I say, where's Illinois? I don't know where he is, because he -- you know, he's wild (inaudible) when he gets -- but I knew him, when I first met him, he was a tap dancer.

Down in Fort Worth, Texas, when I went to -- went down -- I was playing with Cab there, and we played an amateur night, you know, in Fort Worth, and Illinois was tap dancing, and they had a team called Ropo, Nopo and Shobo, and one guy was -- and they would put on a boxing thing, and the other third guy was a referee, and they did this all to music and they tap danced, an amateur contest.
